result.quote: the Lord had caused the Arameans to hear the sound of chariots, horses, and a great army
result.reason: The key uniquely gives the evidence that led the Arameans to infer that Israel had hired other armies. It is supported, though it omits the additional sound of a great army. The question is understandable, but the specific past event would be more naturally phrased, “Why did the Arameans think Israel had hired allies?”
